SELECT b.*, s.name AS store_name FROM ecom_buyer_blacklist b LEFT JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = b.store_id
AND b.match_type = #{matchType} AND b.status = #{status}
AND (b.match_value LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.reason LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY b.id DESC
SELECT b.* FROM ecom_buyer_blacklist b WHERE b.status = 1 AND (b.store_id IS NULL OR b.store_id = #{storeId}) ORDER BY b.id
mapper.update: UPDATE ecom_buyer_blacklist SET hit_count = hit_count + 1, last_hit_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
